items.title: Clínica La Sagrada Familia (Colombia) By whitearmor
items.detail: Clínica La Sagrada Familia S.A.S, a private healthcare provider in Colombia's Eje Cafetero region. It offers medium and high-complexity medical services, online appointment scheduling, and features advanced technology like a 160-slice CT scanner. We hold, in short: 254,670 patient identities with Colombian government IDs, ~598.7M rows of clinical + financial + identity data across 4,573 tables from a Colombian hospital's full production database, including MD5-hashed staff credentials, 691K admissions, 34.5M medical-history rows, 1.5M invoices, and complete pharmacy/lab operations. We demand $2,000,000 in BTC, emails with instructions have been sent to you. If you have not received them, you can find our contacts below. Email: whitearmorxd@onionmail.org Session: 0547b7f96d469ecb332e89d0108e71c92df5bacff6c4ed5b9801ab5fffe872ee67 Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
